meanings.usage: 指英国国教的教区牧师

meanings.meaning: 如果有ed构成形容词，做为形容词读音要读/id/

meanings.usage: 正式用语,表示拥有某种东西或特质
指来访或参观的人,来自 visit
指他人对某人或某事的看法和评价
指出于旅游目的到访的人
strike down 表示击倒、摧毁
pick a leaf 采摘树叶,pick up 捡起
指道德上邪恶的,也可指带来坏运气的

examples.en: The village is said to possess a cursed tree.
examples.zh: 据说这个村庄拥有一棵被诅咒的树。

examples.en: He is said to be a great painter.
examples.zh: 据说他是一位伟大的画家。

phrases.usage: 近年来,用于谈论过去几年发生的事

examples.en: It is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation.
examples.zh: 只是在近年来它才获得了邪恶的名声。

examples.en: Many things have changed in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来许多事情都发生了变化。

examples.en: If anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck.
examples.zh: 如果有人碰了这棵树,他就会倒霉。

examples.en: I had bad luck yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天运气不好。

examples.en: The vicar has refused to have the tree cut down.
examples.zh: 牧师拒绝让人把这棵树砍倒。

examples.en: You should cut down on smoking.
examples.zh: 你应该减少吸烟。

examples.en: He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income.
examples.zh: 他指出这棵树是一个有用的收入来源。

examples.en: Can you point out the mistakes in my essay?
examples.zh: 你能指出我文章中的错误吗？

phrases.usage: 尽管,虽然,用于引出与主句意思相反的内容

examples.en: In spite of all that has been said, the tourists still come.
examples.zh: 尽管说了这么多,游客们仍然来。

examples.en: In spite of the rain, we went out.
examples.zh: 尽管下雨,我们还是出去了。

examples.en: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!
examples.zh: 到目前为止,还没有一个人被突然击倒！

examples.en: Everything has been fine so far.
examples.zh: 到目前为止,一切都很顺利。

phrases.usage: 许多,若干,后接可数名词复数

examples.en: The tree has already claimed a number of victims.
examples.zh: 这棵树已经夺走了许多受害者的生命。

examples.en: A number of students were absent.
examples.zh: 许多学生缺席了。

examples.en: Tourists have been cutting their names on the tree-trunk.
examples.zh: 游客们一直在树干上刻他们的名字。

examples.en: He cut his initials on the tree.
examples.zh: 他在树上刻上了自己名字的首字母。

phrases.usage: 现在完成进行时,表示动作从过去持续到现在

examples.en: Tourists have been coming from all parts of the country.
examples.zh: 游客们一直从全国各地赶来。

examples.en: I have been waiting for you for two hours.
examples.zh: 我已经等了你两个小时。

phrases.usage: /pɔɪnt aʊt/ phrasal verb. 指出,提示（用于指出问题、事实或错误）
/kʌt daʊn/ phrasal verb. 砍倒,削减（cut down the tree 表示砍树,cut down on 表示减少）

grammar.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice) - 现在完成时被动语态
grammar.definition: 现在完成时的被动语态,表示一个动作在过去已经开始,持续到现在,并对现在造成影响,主语是动作的承受者。 当动作的承受者是中心话题,而执行者不重要或未知时使用。课文中的 have been asked, has been refused, have been coming 等都是现在完成进行时的主动语态,表示动作持续进行。

examples.en: The vicar has been asked to have the tree cut down.
examples.zh: 牧师被要求把树砍掉。

examples.en: The tree was planted fifty years ago.
examples.zh: 这棵树是五十年前种下的。

examples.en: Many villagers believe that the tree has claimed victims.
examples.zh: 许多村民相信这棵树已经夺走了受害者的生命。

grammar.title: It is said that... / be said to 结构
grammar.structure: It is said that + 主语 + 谓语 / 主语 + is/are said to + 动词原形/进行时/完成时
grammar.definition: 据说...结构,用于表达传闻或不确定的信息,是间接引语的一种表达方式。 当说话者不是信息的直接来源,而是转述他人的话或传闻时使用。

examples.en: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a 'cursed tree'.
examples.zh: 据说弗里恩利这个小村庄拥有一棵'被诅咒的树'。

examples.en: It is said that the tree is very dangerous.
examples.zh: 据说这棵树很危险。

examples.en: He is said to know the secret.
examples.zh: 据说他知道这个秘密。

grammar.title: It is (only) in recent years that... 强调句型
grammar.structure: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余部分
grammar.definition: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子剩余部分,用于强调句中的某个成分。 当需要特别强调某个词、短语或时间状语时使用,可以帮助表达这是新信息或重要信息。

examples.en: It is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation.
examples.zh: 只是在近年来它才获得了邪恶的名声。

examples.en: It was near the church that the tree was planted.
examples.zh: 正是在教堂附近这棵树被种下的。

examples.en: It is the vicar who has refused to cut down the tree.
examples.zh: 正是牧师拒绝砍倒这棵树的。

patterns.pattern: It is said that + 主语 + 谓语

original.en: It is said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck.
original.zh: 据说如果有人碰了树,他就会倒霉。

imitations.en: It is said that he is very rich.
It is said that the book is worth reading.

patterns.pattern: The tree has already claimed + 数量词 + victims

original.en: Many villagers believe that the tree has already claimed a number of victims.
original.zh: 许多村民相信这棵树已经夺走了许多受害者的生命。

imitations.en: The accident has claimed three victims.
imitations.zh: 这场事故已经造成三人死亡。
地震夺走了许多人的生命。

patterns.pattern: have been + doing (现在完成进行时)

original.en: Tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it.
original.zh: 游客们一直从全国各地赶来观看它。

imitations.en: It has been raining all day.
She has been working here since 2020.
imitations.zh: 她自2020年以来一直在这里工作。

patterns.pattern: So far, not one of them has + 过去分词

original.en: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!
original.zh: 到目前为止,还没有一个人被突然击倒！

imitations.en: So far, not one of them has complained.
imitations.zh: 到目前为止,还没有一个人抱怨过。

imitations.en: So far, not one of the students has finished the exam.
imitations.zh: 到目前为止,还没有一个学生完成考试。

lines.en: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a ' cursed tree'.
lines.zh: 据说弗林利这个小村里有一棵“该诅咒的树”。

lines.en: Because the tree was mentioned in a newspaper, the number of visitors to Frinley has now increased.
lines.zh: 就因为报上提到过这棵树，所以现在来弗林利参观的人越来越多。

lines.en: The tree was planted near the church fifty years ago, but it is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation.
lines.zh: 该树是50年前栽在教堂附近的，但只是近几年才得到了一个坏名声。

lines.en: It is said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck; if he picks a leaf, he will die.
lines.zh: 据说，谁要是触摸了这棵树，谁就会交上恶运；如果谁摘了一片树叶，谁就会死去。

lines.en: Many villagers believe that the tree has already claimed a number of victims.
lines.zh: 很多村民相信此树已经害了不少人。

lines.en: The vicar has been asked to have the tree cut down, but so far he has refused.
lines.zh: 人们曾请求教区的牧师叫人把树砍掉，但他直到现在也没有同意。

lines.en: He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income, as tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it.
lines.zh: 他指出，由于人们从全国各地纷纷前来参观这棵树，它成了一个有用的财源。

lines.en: In spite of all that has been said, the tourists have been picking leaves and cutting their names on the tree-trunk.
lines.zh: 尽管有上述种种说法，但游客们还是照常摘树叶和把他们的名字刻在树干上。

lines.en: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!
lines.zh: 然而到目前为止，还没有一个人暴死呢！

questions.q: Why does the vicar refuse to cut down the tree?
questions.zh: 牧师为什么拒绝把树砍掉？
questions.a: Because he has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income, as tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it.
questions.aZh: 因为牧师指出，全国各地的人纷纷前来观赏这棵树，它成了一个有用的财源。
questions.hint: 出自 He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income…

questions.q: What does 'have the tree cut down' mean, and why won't the vicar do it?
questions.zh: “have the tree cut down”是什么意思？牧师为什么不肯？
questions.a: It means 'ask someone else to cut the tree down' — have + object + past participle. The vicar refuses because the tree is a useful source of income.
questions.aZh: 意为“叫人把树砍掉”（have + 宾语 + 过去分词）。牧师拒绝，因为这棵树是财源。

questions.q: Why does the text say 'the number of visitors ... has now increased' rather than 'have now increased'?
questions.zh: 为什么用 has now increased 而不是 have now increased？
questions.a: Because the head word is 'number', not 'visitors': 'the number of' takes a singular verb, while 'a number of' meaning 'many' takes a plural verb.
questions.aZh: 因为主语的中心词是 number（数量），谓语用单数；“a number of”意为“许多”，谓语才用复数。
questions.hint: the number of + 复数名词，谓语仍用单数。

questions.q: What does 'It is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation' emphasise?
questions.zh: 强调的到底是哪一部分？
questions.a: It emphasises the time adverbial 'only in recent years': the tree was planted near the church fifty years ago, but it became notorious only in recent years.
questions.aZh: 强调时间状语 only in recent years：树五十年前就栽在教堂旁，却直到近几年才得了个坏名声。
questions.hint: It is ... that 强调句型。

questions.q: Is the 'cursed tree' really a curse for Frinley, or a blessing in disguise?
questions.zh: 这棵“该诅咒的树”对弗林利来说究竟是祸还是福？
questions.a: The tree is said to have claimed a number of victims, but the newspaper report has drawn tourists and the vicar points out that it is a useful source of income — so it looks like a blessing in disguise. The question mark leaves the final judgement to the reader.
questions.aZh: 树被说成夺去人命的祸根，却因报纸报道引来游客，牧师也指出它是财源——似是因祸得福。标题的问号把判断权留给读者。
questions.hint: 结合 so far not one of them has been struck down。

translation:
据说弗林利这个小村里有一棵“该诅咒的树”。
就因为报上提到过这棵树，所以现在来弗林利参观的人越来越多。
该树是50年前栽在教堂附近的，但只是近几年才得到了一个坏名声。
据说，谁要是触摸了这棵树，谁就会交上恶运；如果谁摘了一片树叶，谁就会死去。
很多村民相信此树已经害了不少人。
人们曾请求教区的牧师叫人把树砍掉，但他直到现在也没有同意。
他指出，由于人们从全国各地纷纷前来参观这棵树，它成了一个有用的财源。
尽管有上述种种说法，但游客们还是照常摘树叶和把他们的名字刻在树干上。
然而到目前为止，还没有一个人暴死呢！
title: A Blessing in Disguise?
subtitle: 是祸是福？

lead.question: 一棵人人避之不及的“该诅咒的树”，为何被牧师当成有用的财源？
lead.warmup: 弗林利本是个不起眼的小村子，却因一棵“该诅咒的树”远近闻名。报纸一报道，游客便从全国各地涌来：据说摸树会倒霉，摘一片叶子就会死去。村民请求牧师叫人把树砍掉，牧师却至今不肯。他算的是另一笔账——这棵树给村子带来了源源不断的收入。
goals: 掌握 be said to do、It is said that 与 There is said to be 三种“据说”表达及互换
理解 have sth done 使役结构，以及 so far 与现在完成时的固定搭配
辨析 the number of 与 a number of、gain 与 earn 的用法
认识 It is/was ... that ... 强调句型，能复述牧师拒砍树的理由
lead.summary: 本课语法重点是被动语态的“谨慎说法”：主语 + be said + to do 与 It is said that 意思相同；还有 There is said to be 这一更口语的变体。词汇方面要掌握 have the tree cut down、so far 配现在完成时、gain an evil reputation、claim victims、in spite of。
lead.tips: have sth done 是“叫别人做”，cut down 用过去分词（cut）；so far 须配现在完成时，别写成 he refused。

exercises.q: 解释标题中的 a blessing in disguise，并说明它在课文中指什么。
exercises.a: a blessing in disguise 意为“因祸得福、表面是祸实则是福”。课文中指那棵被称作“该诅咒的树”的老树：名声吓人，却因报纸报道引来游客，成了村子的财源。

exercises.q: 翻译：据说弗林利这个小村里有一棵“该诅咒的树”。
exercises.a: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a 'cursed tree'.

exercises.q: 用 It is said that 与 There is said to be 两种句式改写上一句。
exercises.a: It is said that the tiny village of Frinley possesses a 'cursed tree'. / There is said to be a 'cursed tree' in the tiny village of Frinley.

exercises.q: 填空：The number of visitors to Frinley ___ now ___ (increase).
exercises.note: the number of 作主语，谓语用单数。

exercises.q: 翻译并说明结构：人们曾请求教区牧师叫人把教堂旁那棵树砍掉。
exercises.a: The vicar has been asked to have the tree near the church cut down.（have + 宾语 + 过去分词，动作由别人完成）

exercises.q: 根据课文填空：The tree was p___ near the church fifty years ago, but it has g___ an evil reputation. It is said to have c___ a number of victims, yet the vicar has p___ out that the tree is a useful s___ of i___.
exercises.a: planted; gained; claimed; pointed; source; income
exercises.note: gain 得名声；claim 夺去生命。

exercises.q: 翻译：尽管有上述种种说法，游客们还是照常摘树叶、把名字刻在树干上，而到目前为止还没有一个人暴死。
exercises.a: In spite of all that has been said, the tourists have been picking leaves and cutting their names on the tree-trunk. So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!
exercises.note: so far 配现在完成时。

quiz.q: 课文中“据说这个小村子有一棵该诅咒的树”，正确的英文表达是？
options: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a 'cursed tree'.
The tiny village of Frinley is said that possesses a 'cursed tree'.
It is said the tiny village of Frinley to possess a 'cursed tree'.
The tiny village of Frinley said to possess a 'cursed tree'.

quiz.q: 与 It is said that there is a great deal of oil in Africa 同义、且更口语的说法是？
options: There is said to be a great deal of oil in Africa.
There said is a great deal of oil in Africa.
There is said being a great deal of oil in Africa.
There has said to be a great deal of oil in Africa.

quiz.q: 牧师被要求“叫人把树砍掉”，正确的表达是？
options: have the tree cut down
have the tree cutting down
have the tree to cut down
have the tree cutted down
quiz.note: cut 的过去分词仍为 cut。

quiz.q: The number of visitors to Frinley ___ now increased. 空白处应填入？
options: has
have
are
were
quiz.note: the number of 作主语时谓语用单数。

quiz.q: 课文中“只是近几年才得到了一个坏名声”，正确的搭配是？
options: gained an evil reputation
made an evil reputation
gained an evil fame
took an evil reputation
quiz.note: gain a reputation 为固定搭配。

quiz.q: “到目前为止还没有一个人暴死”，与课文一致的句子是？
options: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!
So far, not one of them was struck down by sudden death!
So far, not one of them has struck down by sudden death!
So far, not one of them had been striking down by sudden death!
quiz.note: so far 配现在完成时被动。
